changeSet.author: filmon
changeSet.comment: Add is_cbhi column to payers table for CBHI identification
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE payers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_cbhi BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payers_is_cbhi ON payers(is_cbhi);
UPDATE payers SET is_cbhi = true WHERE LOWER(payer_name) LIKE '%cbhi%' OR LOWER(payer_name) LIKE '%community%health%insurance%' OR LOWER(description) LIKE '%cbhi%';
